asset_parent_purpose.name: asset_parent_purpose
asset_parent_purpose.value: ("asset"."post_id" is null or "asset"."purpose" = 'post') and ("asset"."comment_id" is null or "asset"."purpose" = 'comment') and ("asset"."event_id" is null or "asset"."purpose" in ('event_photo', 'event_document')) and ("asset"."company_id" is null or "asset"."purpose" = 'company_document')

asset_image_size.name: asset_image_size
asset_image_size.value: ("asset"."kind" = 'image') = ("asset"."width" is not null and "asset"."height" is not null)

board_member_years.name: board_member_years
board_member_years.value: ("board_member"."start_year" is null or "board_member"."start_year" between 1990 and 2100) and ("board_member"."end_year" is null or "board_member"."end_year" between 1990 and 2100) and ("board_member"."start_year" is null or "board_member"."end_year" is null or "board_member"."end_year" >= "board_member"."start_year")

cohort_representative_years.name: cohort_representative_years
cohort_representative_years.value: ("cohort_representative"."start_year" is null or "cohort_representative"."start_year" between 1990 and 2100) and ("cohort_representative"."end_year" is null or "cohort_representative"."end_year" between 1990 and 2100) and ("cohort_representative"."start_year" is null or "cohort_representative"."end_year" is null or "cohort_representative"."end_year" >= "cohort_representative"."start_year")

company_link_request_years.name: company_link_request_years
company_link_request_years.value: ("company_link_request"."start_year" is null or "company_link_request"."start_year" between 1950 and 2100) and ("company_link_request"."end_year" is null or "company_link_request"."end_year" between 1950 and 2100) and ("company_link_request"."start_year" is null or "company_link_request"."end_year" is null or "company_link_request"."end_year" >= "company_link_request"."start_year")

event_date_precision.name: event_date_precision
event_date_precision.value: "event"."date_precision" = 'day' or ("event"."end_date" is null and extract(day from "event"."start_date") = 1 and (extract(month from "event"."start_date") = 1 or ("event"."date_precision" = 'semester' and extract(month from "event"."start_date") = 7)))

experience_years.name: experience_years
experience_years.value: ("experience"."start_year" is null or "experience"."start_year" between 1950 and 2100) and ("experience"."end_year" is null or "experience"."end_year" between 1950 and 2100) and ("experience"."start_year" is null or "experience"."end_year" is null or "experience"."end_year" >= "experience"."start_year")
